findings.title: Passkey form attributes are set on a form that is not used for the username-only login page
findings.body: The branch around line 115 now calls webauthnAuth.fillContextForm(context) when a user is already set. fillContextForm sets a new challenge auth note and sets attributes on context.form(). UsernameForm now skips its success shortcut and falls through to super.authenticate in that case. That is the intended re-authentication path. However, this means the challenge note is overwritten on every re-render, including after a failed password attempt. A passkey page left open in another tab then fails challenge validation. This is a minor robustness issue.

findings.title: Missing @Override on overriding method
findings.body: shouldShowWebAuthnAuthenticators overrides the parent method but has no @Override annotation. If the parent signature changes, the override silently stops working.

findings.title: Catch of a generic Exception swallows the test's own failure
findings.body: The try block calls fail(...) when the webauth form is found. fail() throws AssertionError, which is an Error, so it is not caught by catch(Exception). The nullValue() assertion on a findElement result would also throw NoSuchElementException, so the check is convoluted. If an element is present, the nullValue assertion throws AssertionError, which propagates correctly. The real concern is the catch of all Exceptions, which hides unrelated driver errors. Use findElements().isEmpty() instead.
